messages.author: 4b681bcd9d4d425d
messages.subject: Adding samples to a run?
parts:
Hi all,

If I have completed a model run, and I want to reuse the warmup and generate addition samples, is this possible? Can it be done in RStan?

(For diagnosing problems, or to generate more coverage in the tails of the distribution, for example.)

Thanks,
David Manheim

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Adding samples to a run?
parts:
Not yet. This keeps coming up. We hope to get to this soon
after the big refactor of commands lands, but we're not sure
when that'll be.

For now, just keep doubling *both* warmup and sampling stages
until you get convergence and high enough effective sample
size. You almost always want longer warmup if you haven't
gotten high enough n_eff or convergence. The only time
you want to do what you suggest is when you know warmup
has converged across chains and you have almost but not
quite high enough n_eff for some purpose.

- Bob
